overview: A beginner roadmap for planning, practicing, and delivering clearer talks with confidence.

phases.title: Speech Foundations
phases.goal: Understand audience, message, and simple speech structure.

nodes.title: Audience and purpose
nodes.description: Decide who the speech is for and what they should remember. A clear purpose reduces rambling and anxiety.

nodes.title: Speech structure
nodes.description: Learn how to create a beginning, middle, and ending that are easy to follow. Practice outlining before writing full sentences.

nodes.title: Overcome nervousness
nodes.description: Learn simple breathing, preparation, and reframing techniques. The goal is to manage nerves, not remove them completely.

resources.title: How to speak so that people want to listen

project.title: Two-minute introduction speech
project.brief: Prepare and record a two-minute introduction speech with a clear opening, three points, and a closing line.

phases.title: Delivery Skills
phases.goal: Improve voice, body language, and practice habits.

nodes.title: Voice and pacing
nodes.description: Practice speaking slowly enough to be understood and using pauses for emphasis. Record yourself to notice patterns.

resources.title: How to sound smart in your TEDx Talk

nodes.title: Body language
nodes.description: Use posture, eye contact, and gestures to support your message. Keep movement intentional and comfortable.

resources.title: Your body language may shape who you are

nodes.title: Practice routine
nodes.description: Practice in short sessions with one focus each time. Use feedback from recordings instead of trying to fix everything at once.

project.title: Recorded how-to talk
project.brief: Give a three-minute how-to talk on a familiar topic, then review pacing, eye contact, and structure.

phases.title: Real Presentations
phases.goal: Plan and deliver a polished beginner presentation.

nodes.title: Visual aids
nodes.description: Use slides or notes only when they help the audience follow. Keep visuals simple and avoid reading from them.

nodes.title: Handle questions
nodes.description: Prepare for likely questions and practice answering briefly. It is acceptable to pause before responding.

nodes.title: Get feedback
nodes.description: Ask listeners for specific feedback on clarity, pacing, and confidence. Use the feedback to revise the next version.

project.title: Five-minute final presentation
project.brief: Deliver a five-minute presentation with a simple visual aid, record it, and write three improvements for the next attempt.
